title: The Borrowed Postcards
author: Mara Iversen
blurb: Xanthe Okafor, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the house sale closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
